purpose: Alternative newer multilingual model control after native repair limitations.
data: Existing400-case bilingual instruction screen; reused synthetic evidence, not reserved or independent.
recipe: Fixed binary policy, thinking disabled, one next-token decision, full-vocabulary top token must be0or1 else abstain. Score is conditional two-token softmax, uncalibrated. No threshold fit, cutoff0.5.
memory: Project only final hidden state; verify label probabilities and vocabulary argmax against full projection; common-prefix cache checked against uncached first two complete prompts. Tolerance0.001.
selection: No training, model or prompt selection based on reserved inputs. Full release qualification remains separate.
arithmetic_amendment: Initial bfloat16 last-token projection check failed before any example was evaluated. Use model.set_dtype(float32), retaining packed4bit weights, and rerun unchanged projection/cache parity tolerances before evaluating the screen.
